descriptor.name: France IGN/DGFiP Parcellaire Express (PCI)
descriptor.scope: National IGN assembly of DGFiP PCI Vecteur cadastral parcels. This candidate is limited to the unchanged La Rochelle settlement point and thirteen local 0.001-degree cells; municipal completeness and legal boundary accuracy are unverified.
descriptor.attribution: IGN/DGFiP Parcellaire Express (PCI), Licence Ouverte 2.0; public WFS checked 2026-10-11.

evidence: IGN first-party catalogue https://www.data.gouv.fr/datasets/parcellaire-express-pci identifies a national assembly of DGFiP PCI Vecteur cadastral parcels and links https://data.geopf.fr/wfs/ows. Live WFS capabilities identify CADASTRALPARCELS.PARCELLAIRE_EXPRESS:parcelle; DescribeFeatureType confirms idu string and geom MultiSurface. The frozen La Rochelle packet independently read native IDs 17300000AP0069, 17300000AP0070 and 17300000AP0071 at the unchanged locator; first-party https://geo.api.gouv.fr/communes/17300 confirms commune 17300 is La Rochelle. See evidence/source-inspection.json for bounded public responses and hashes.
